summary: Iter-28 discard/restart bug fix fully validated end-to-end. Backend (pytest 7/7 PASSED): (1) POST /manual-pay/{tid}/discard on unverified → {success:true, state:cancelled} + GET tid → 404; (2) discard after mismatched ₹10 vs ₹5 receipt verification succeeds and GET tid → 404; (3) POST /restart → new tid, state=awaiting_merchant_payment, merchant_amount preserved (10), payee_upi preserved, utr_full null, verification null, old tid → 404; (4) supersede: first_scan while another attempt active auto-cancels old attempt (old GET → 404); (5) verified-payment protection: verified txn → discard 400 (‘finalized’) AND restart 400 (‘already verified’); (6) discard of nonexistent id → 404; (7) restart of a cancelled tid → 400. Frontend (Playwright, public URL, real Gemini OCR): full ACCEPTANCE scenario passes — register uitest_<ts>@bill4pe.in → login → /app/pay tea@okaxis ₹10 → payment-done-btn → upload PIL receipt with Rs.5 → verification-card shows ‘PAYMENT NOT VERIFIED’ → Discard Bill & Start New opens discard-confirm-modal → Keep Bill closes modal & preserves session (verification-card still visible) → clicking again + Discard & Start New navigates to /app/capture, clears localStorage bill4pe_manual_txn AND sessionStorage bill4pe_draft, and old tid returns 404 via API → new /app/pay with chai@okaxis ₹20 shows fresh payee form (no verification-card, no old UTR) and BILL AMOUNT ₹20.00 → hard refresh keeps state fresh, old ₹10 tid does NOT return. Additional Playwright: (A) ‘Start new payment’ (restart) on a failed verification cancels the old attempt server-side (GET old tid → 404), stores a NEW tid, screen shows fresh ‘pay the merchant’ step for the SAME ₹10 bill (state=awaiting_merchant_payment, utr null, verification null, no receipt/verification-card). (B) Amount-change invalidation: with a stale ₹10 attempt live, setting sessionStorage bill4pe_draft to items totalling 20 and visiting /app/pay auto-discards the old attempt (API GET → 404) and shows a fresh payee form with BILL AMOUNT ₹20.00.
critical_code_review_comments: manual_flow_service.first_scan supersedes any active attempt without bill_id/fee=paid, which is correct — but the supersede $set uses cancel_reason 'superseded_by_new_attempt' AND state 'cancelled'. If in future another surface (e.g. dashboard history) filters on state != 'cancelled' this will silently hide the audit trail. Consider also stamping superseded_at for reporting.

manual_flow_service.discard/restart do not update the receipt_verifications collection. That is intentional (audit-only) but the verified-UTR partial index still holds ONLY for verification_status=='verified'. Because rejected records are excluded from the unique index (per iter-27 fix), a user can retry after a genuine typo — good. However restart clones payee/amount but leaves any latest 'verification' object on the OLD txn only; a support engineer looking up the NEW tid will not see the previous rejected OCR. Consider linking replaces_attempt → prior_verification_id for support triage.

PayNow.jsx uses two overlapping controls: 'Start new payment' (restart same bill) and 'Discard Bill & Start New' (cancel bill, /app/capture). The labels are close enough that users may mis-click. Consider tightening copy or moving the destructive ‘Discard’ into a menu.

PayNow.jsx line 107 RESUMABLE is declared inside the render body — ESLint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps flags it (already noted in the build). Move to module scope to silence the warning and avoid re-creating the array each render.

manual_pay.py restart route returns _public(new_doc) but the response envelope key ‘transaction_id’ is used by the frontend. Confirmed working, but consider explicit response schema so future consumers know utr_full / verification are always null on a fresh attempt.
test_credentials: Super admin (unused for this iter): meland@mhem.in / Bill4pe@123. Regular users registered on the fly: uitest_<ts>@bill4pe.in / Test@1234.
seed_data_creation: Each run registers a fresh @bill4pe.in user and creates manual_transactions + receipt_verifications records via real Gemini OCR. UTRs are microsecond-unique to avoid the verified-UTR partial index collision.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL /api/auth/register requires @bill4pe.in domain and has ~1/4s rate limit — cache the first-issued token or sleep 4s. Login redirects meland@mhem.in to /superadmin so use a freshly-registered @bill4pe.in user for /app flows. After clicking start-payment-btn, the same page reveals payment-done-btn; after payment-done-btn the visually-hidden receipt-upload-input accepts set_input_files. Real Gemini OCR usually returns in 6–20s (allow up to 60s). PayNow exposes both start-new-payment (restart – keeps bill) AND discard-bill-btn (destructive, needs modal confirm via discard-confirm-btn or discard-keep-btn to close). Storage keys: localStorage.bill4pe_manual_txn and sessionStorage.bill4pe_draft — both are cleared on discard. Backend contract: GET /manual-pay/{tid} returns 404 for cancelled transactions (get_status returns None). Tests file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter28_discard_restart.py — run with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest ... -o addopts=''` because pytest.ini enables xdist which is fine but preserves the same command shape.
rca of the issue: N/A — all fixed behaviors observed correctly. No regression in existing happy path (start-payment-btn + payment-done-btn + upload receipt still works and matches iter-27 baseline).
